name: Nicole
site: engie-deutschland.de · Energy and building services, Germany
headline: Turn Engie’s usage data into contracts that stay.
saw: Your homepage sells energy services and energy solutions to industry, real estate, municipalities and data centres, and every visitor sees the same sector menu and the same service list, whether they run a plant or a hospital.

Customers on your energy monitoring or contracting services generate consumption and usage signals that show the next service they need and the first sign they are drifting. That signal sits in analytics, not in the message they receive.

Cross-sell, upsell and retention campaigns are built by hand, per sector, per quarter: a Biomethan offer for one segment, a monitoring offer for another. The customer about to leave this month gets the same mail as everyone else, or none.
help_intro: Three places where an AI that decides per customer, not per segment, pays for itself in the first quarter.

cases.head: Act before the contract is lost
cases.text: Churn signals per account from consumption, service contacts and renewal timing. The right offer, channel and moment, picked for each customer and tested across your B2B base.
cases.kpi_label: lower churn, measured at Flytxt telecom clients

cases.head: Match each account to the next service
cases.text: Next best service per account for monitoring, Biomethan, contracting and renewable energy, triggered by what they actually use. No more blanket campaigns to customers who already have the service.
cases.kpi_label: conversion vs untargeted campaigns, Tier-1 African MNO

cases.head: Keep every account using your services
cases.text: Personal nudges by email and on your website, pointing each account to the monitoring view or service they have not used yet, so every account has a reason to return.
cases.kpi_label: streaming activity at an OTT client
